event_definitions.admission_retry: A new admission attempt after an explicitly rejected native invocation; not a code repair.
event_definitions.agent_start: Successful admission of a fresh probe agent; rejected admissions are not starts.
event_definitions.ci_repair: A code/test correction responding to CI failure within this probe scope.
event_definitions.handoff: One transfer of the frozen packet to the probe or original response to the coordinator.
event_definitions.implementation_repair: A code/test correction after a failed implementation check within this probe scope.
event_definitions.review_repair: A code/test correction responding to an independent review within this probe scope.
